extDescription.message: Boosts quiet videos up to 600% and evens out loudness: louder dialog, quieter explosions. Works on any site.

hintOff.message: Volume boost only, the original dynamics stay as they are.

hintLight.message: Smooths out the biggest jumps, music keeps its dynamics.

hintMedium.message: Dialog and action at a similar level. Good for films and shows.

hintStrong.message: Everything at one level. For night time and noisy rooms.

statusOff.message: Turned off. Videos already playing will play as they are until you turn it back on.

statusNone.message: No sound on this tab yet. Start a video and the extension picks it up.

statusUnsupported.message: Browser pages and extension stores can't be processed.

statusWaiting.message: Click anywhere on the page: the browser only starts audio processing after a click.

statusDrm.message: This video is copy-protected (DRM). The browser doesn't let extensions process its sound, so it plays unchanged.

statusCors.message: This video comes from another server that doesn't allow processing. It plays unchanged so the sound doesn't drop out.

statusStream.message: Voice and video calls are left untouched.

statusBusy.message: The site processes this video's sound itself, the extension can't connect to it.

statusReload.message: If the sound disappeared, turn the extension off for this site and reload the page.
